scripts.dev: npm run build:prompts && npm run build:web && node scripts/dev-worker-local.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:prompts && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: cd web && node scripts/build-html.mjs && vite build --config vite.layout.config.ts && node scripts/build-vue-pages.mjs && node scripts/build-legacy-pages.mjs
scripts.backtest:institutional-top100:refresh: npm run generate:institutional-tracks && npm run backtest:institutional-top100
scripts.backtest:institutional-top100:triggered-: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --stock-limit 100 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 18 --analysis-cohort triggered --first-loss-pcts 10,15,20,25,30 --second-loss-pcts 20,25,30,35,40 --sell-fractions 35,50,70 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top100-近5年实际触发减仓样本回测.md
scripts.backtest:institutional-top100:cash-ladde: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --strategy cash-ladder --stock-limit 100 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 6 --initial-cash-pcts 20,35,50 --first-loss-pcts 10,15,20 --second-loss-pcts 20,25,30,35,40 --cash-buy-splits 35/65,50/50,65/35 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top100-近5年预留现金分批买入回测.md

node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --strategy cash-ladder --cash-baseline full-stock --stock-limit 100 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 6 --initial-cash-pcts 20,35,50 --first-loss-pcts 10,15,20 --second-loss-pcts 20,25,30,35,40 --cash-buy-splits 35/65,50/50,65/35 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top100-近5年预留现金分批买入对比全仓死扛回测.md
scripts.backtest:institutional-top300:industry: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --stock-limit 300 --concurrency 13 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top300-行业分层减仓加仓回测.md
scripts.backtest:institutional-top300:industry:r: npm run generate:institutional-tracks && npm run backtest:institutional-top300:industry
scripts.backtest:institutional-top300:industry:3: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --stock-limit 300 --from 2023-07-31 --concurrency 13 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top300-近3年行业分层减仓加仓回测.md
scripts.backtest:institutional-top300:industry:5: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --stock-limit 300 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 18 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top300-近5年行业分层减仓加仓回测.md
scripts.backtest:institutional-top300:reduce-add: node scripts/backtest-current-institutional-top100-reduce-add.mjs --stock-limit 300 --from 2021-07-31 --concurrency 18 --first-loss-pcts 10,15,20,25,30 --second-loss-pcts 20,25,30,35,40 --sell-fractions 35,50,70 --output docs/research/当前机构持股Top300-近5年阈值仓位网格回测.md
scripts.backtest:multi-asset:price-rotation:5y: node scripts/backtest-multi-asset-allocation.mjs --from 2021-07-31 --to 2026-07-31 --rotation-mode price --rotation-weights 70/30 --price-lookback-days 60 --output docs/research/多资产配置回测-价格轮动.md
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_HIDE_BANNER=true wrangler d1 migrations apply stock_info --local
